## Page 1

Exhibitor and partner risk assessment

<!-- @body.title -->
Your stand at [[[Edition]]]

<!-- @body.lead -->
Complete this for your stand or activation and send it to exhibitors@climb-uk.com by the deadline in your contract. The spreadsheet version scores each row for you.

<!-- @body.h2 -->
How to complete it

<!-- @body.numbers -->
1. Complete your details below.
2. Each row is one hazard, not one item. Work left to right.
3. Add rows for anything unusual: games, interactive experiences, food or drink, machines or moving parts.
4. Score likelihood and severity 1 to 5 before and after your controls.
5. Check it before you submit, and update it if your plans change.

<!-- @body.h2 -->
Scoring

<!-- @body.p -->
Likelihood: 1 Rare, 2 Unlikely, 3 Possible, 4 Likely, 5 Almost certain. Severity: 1 Minor injury or inconvenience, 2 First aid required, 3 Injury requiring medical treatment, 4 Serious injury, 5 Major injury or fatality. Score is likelihood times severity: Low 1 to 4, Medium 5 to 9, High 10 to 15, Critical 16 to 25. A High or Critical score needs more controls before the event; tell us at exhibitors@climb-uk.com.
